{{Quote|The one you seek has been working for Boss Shon Ti'ja. You can find him in the menagerie on Alekie island.|Bricka Thomor|<ref name="The Smuggler's Code" />}}
This '''menagerie''' was a building located on [[Alekie Island]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wielu]]. Crime boss [[Shon Ti'Ja]] used it as his headquarters, and it contained several dangerous creatures&mdash;a [[sloat]], a snake-like creation; several [[Saberfish/Legends|saberfish]] kept in a water-filled pit; and at least two other unidentified species. These creatures had been taken from their natural habitats because they were considered too dangerous to remain once resorts were built across the planet<ref name="The Smuggler's Code" />

In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]  [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Rook Pryce]] went to the menagerie in search of [[T'mott Zoat]], a dangerous criminal that Kenobi has been pursuing. They received a tip from [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] [[Bricka Thomor]] that Zoat had been hired by Ti'Ja and was hiding at the menagerie. However, Thomor betrayed them by informing Ti'Ja of their arrival, and Ti'Ja prepared an ambush. He set his creatures against them, but the two emerged victorious and imprisoned him inside one of the glass cells.<ref name="The Smuggler's Code" />
